title: Off-record source: the sun as a portal to other star systems

tellings.quote: And he made this analogy of the sun being some sort of like portal to other star systems.

plain: Podcast host Jesse Michels says that a source who spoke to him off the record compared the sun to a kind of portal leading to other star systems. If true, it would suggest that visitors could travel between stars through the sun rather than across empty space.
